_doc: NEMA NU 2-2018 Image Quality phantom VOIs, T6. Geometry transcribed verbatim from reconstruction/results/2026-04-24_1039_nema_iq/nema_iq_200M.mac. THE WHOLE PHANTOM IS WATER: spheres and background share tau_cfg = 1.80 ns, and the only contrast is a 10:1 per-volume ACTIVITY ratio. That makes this a null test for lifetime -- any sphere-vs-background tau difference is a bias induced by activity contrast and the prompt-matching rule, not by the phantom.

phantom_outline._note: NEMA IQ body: 220 mm diameter x 180 mm length water cylinder, macro lines 46-51.

vois._note: Rmax 18.5 mm at (-68.5, 0, 0). Water, 10x background activity concentration.

vois.name: background_central
vois._note: Central background. The spheres sit at radius 68.5 mm and span r in [50, 87] mm, so r < 40 mm is sphere-free with 10 mm to spare. Axial half-extent 40 mm keeps it inside the 90 mm half-length and away from the axial edges.
